title: Instruction-Tuned LLM
description: Language model fine-tuned on instruction datasets and aligned using human feedback.
name: Instruction-Tuned LLM
summary: Instruction-Tuned LLMs are base language models fine-tuned on instruction-following datasets and aligned using reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) or direct preference optimization (DPO) to produce helpful, harmless assistants.
use_when: Building user-facing conversational applications, chat interfaces, or goal-oriented agents.
avoid_when: Performing raw text completion tasks or when unbiased, unaligned probabilities are preferred.
pros: Follows user instructions and system prompts natively.
Maintains safe boundaries and declines harmful requests.
cons: Alignment can cause 'sycophancy' or reduce creativity on open-ended tasks.
Higher sensitivity to system prompt structures.
Vulnerable to jailbreak prompts that bypass safety alignments.

key_hyperparams.name: max_new_tokens
key_hyperparams.note: Maximum number of generated output tokens. Prevents infinite generation loops.
